title: The Morning Digest: October 21, 2026
dek: The November Mainline apportionment notice landed Tuesday: Light 19 percent and Heavy 7 percent at Kerrobert, up from October's 8 and 4 percent, with further cuts at Cromer, Superior and Clearbrook. December WCS settled at -$27.95 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 20) on 569 lots, its first traded volume of the episode. Brent touched $111.99 intraday Tuesday, its highest in five months, then settled down $0.76 at $108.79 after Iran's president discussed mediation efforts with Pakistan's army chief; overnight Brent recovered to $110.38 and WTI December to $99.18 at 0350 GMT (Reuters). The API reported US crude stocks down 4.93 Mbbl and distillates down 2.6 Mbbl for the week ending Oct 16, ahead of today's EIA report, and the diesel crack closed Tuesday at $105.06 on the validated history. The Baltic Week 42 weekly shows tanker freight peaking on every major route, with TD9 (Caribbean to US Gulf Coast) at WS 830, down 198 points.
